import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 1000000009;
    static int[] headEdge, distLevel, current;
    static ArrayList<Integer> toNode, nextEdge, edgeCap;
    static int src, sink;
    static int n, m, deadline;
    static char[][] sci, rea;
    static int[][] danger;

    static boolean valid(int r, int c) {
        return r >= 0 && c >= 0 && r < n && c < m;
    }

    static int idCell(int x, int y) {
        return 1 + m * x + y;
    }

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int c) {
        int id = toNode.size();
        toNode.add(v);
        edgeCap.add(c);
        nextEdge.add(headEdge[u]);
        headEdge[u] = id;

        toNode.add(u);
        edgeCap.add(0);
        nextEdge.add(headEdge[v]);
        headEdge[v] = id + 1;
    }

    static boolean bfs() {
        Arrays.fill(distLevel, -1);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(src);
        distLevel[src] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (int e = headEdge[u]; e != -1; e = nextEdge.get(e)) {
                int v = toNode.get(e);
                if (distLevel[v] == -1 && edgeCap.get(e) > 0) {
                    distLevel[v] = distLevel[u] + 1;
                    q.add(v);
                    if (v == sink) return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static long dfs(int u, int f) {
        if (f == 0) return 0;
        if (u == sink) return f;
        int e = current[u];
        while (e != -1) {
            int v = toNode.get(e);
            if (distLevel[v] == distLevel[u] + 1 && edgeCap.get(e) > 0) {
                long pushed = dfs(v, Math.min(f, edgeCap.get(e)));
                if (pushed > 0) {
                    edgeCap.set(e, edgeCap.get(e) - (int)pushed);
                    edgeCap.set(e ^ 1, edgeCap.get(e ^ 1) + (int)pushed);
                    return pushed;
                }
            }
            e = nextEdge.get(e);
            current[u] = e;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static long maxflow() {
        long ans = 0;
        while (bfs()) {
            System.arraycopy(headEdge, 0, current, 0, headEdge.length);
            long pushed;
            while ((pushed = dfs(src, INF)) > 0) ans += pushed;
        }
        return ans;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        deadline = sc.nextInt() + 1;
        m = n;

        sci = new char[n][m];
        rea = new char[n][m];
        danger = new int[n][m];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            sci[i] = sc.next().toCharArray();
        }

        Queue<int[]> q0 = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            rea[i] = sc.next().toCharArray();
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                danger[i][j] = INF;
                if (rea[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    q0.add(new int[]{i, j});
                    danger[i][j] = 1;
                }
            }
        }

        while (!q0.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q0.poll();
            int x = cur[0], y = cur[1];
            for (int dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
                for (int dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++) {
                    if (Math.abs(dx) + Math.abs(dy) != 1) continue;
                    int nx = x + dx, ny = y + dy;
                    if (valid(nx, ny) && danger[nx][ny] == INF && sci[nx][ny] != 'Y') {
                        danger[nx][ny] = danger[x][y] + 1;
                        q0.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        src = 0;
        sink = n * n + n * n + 1;
        int nodes = n * n * 2 + 2;
        headEdge = new int[nodes];
        Arrays.fill(headEdge, -1);
        toNode = new ArrayList<>();
        nextEdge = new ArrayList<>();
        edgeCap = new ArrayList<>();
        distLevel = new int[nodes];
        current = new int[nodes];

        for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
            for (int y = 0; y < m; y++) {
                if (sci[x][y] >= '1' && sci[x][y] <= '9')
                    addEdge(src, idCell(x, y), sci[x][y] - '0');
                if (rea[x][y] >= '1' && rea[x][y] <= '9')
                    addEdge(n * n + idCell(x, y), sink, rea[x][y] - '0');

                for (int X = 0; X < n; X++) {
                    for (int Y = 0; Y < m; Y++) {
                        if (sci[x][y] == 'Y' || sci[x][y] == 'Z' || rea[X][Y] == 'Y' || rea[X][Y] == 'Z')
                            continue;

                        boolean[][] seen = new boolean[n][m];
                        Queue<int[]> q1 = new LinkedList<>();
                        q1.add(new int[]{x, y, 1});
                        seen[x][y] = true;
                        boolean found = false;
                        while (!q1.isEmpty()) {
                            int[] cur2 = q1.poll();
                            int cx = cur2[0], cy = cur2[1], tim = cur2[2];
                            if (cx == X && cy == Y) {
                                found = true;
                                break;
                            }
                            if (tim >= danger[cx][cy] || tim >= deadline) continue;
                            for (int dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
                                for (int dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++) {
                                    if (Math.abs(dx) + Math.abs(dy) != 1) continue;
                                    int nx = cx + dx, ny = cy + dy;
                                    if (valid(nx, ny) && !seen[nx][ny] &&
                                        sci[nx][ny] != 'Y' && sci[nx][ny] != 'Z' &&
                                        tim + 1 <= danger[nx][ny]) {
                                        seen[nx][ny] = true;
                                        q1.add(new int[]{nx, ny, tim + 1});
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        if (found)
                            addEdge(idCell(x, y), n * n + idCell(X, Y), INF);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(maxflow());
        sc.close();
    }
}
